tools.name: guide
tools.description: How to use this server: what the index holds, what the scores mean, what it will not do. Call this first, before any other tool.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Filter the agenticjobs.dev index by free-text and structured constraints. Returns up to `limit` rows sorted by vibe-coding fit, each description cut to 240 characters. The strongest single tool — call this first.

tools.name: fetch_jobs
tools.description: Whole job descriptions for up to 25 postings named by id, in one call. Use this before judging anything — search_jobs summaries are too short to form an opinion on.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Single job with the full description and the LLM scoring reason.

tools.name: vibe_top
tools.description: Top N roles by vibe-coding fit — use when the user just wants the best matches without supplying filters.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Aggregate counts: total, good-matches, by source, plus when the index was last refreshed.
